verdict.rationale: The only calendar-related evidence is Gemini in Gmail's 'Schedule' capability, which proposes meeting times from the user's Google Calendar availability inside Gmail. This is thin, glancing calendar integration. Viewing the calendar, responding to invites, and creating events in the email client are not documented. Workspace add-ons are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: an in-client calendar view, RSVP/respond-to-invite from email, event creation from Gmail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
